parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Multiply numerator and denominator by $1+2i$, or equivalent. Requires at least one of $2+10i+12i^2$ and $1-4i^2$ together with use of $i^2=-1$; can be implied by $(-10+10i)/5$. [M1]
Obtain quotient $-2+2i$. [A1]
Alternative: equate to $x+iy$, obtain two equations $x+2y=2$, $y-2x=6$, and solve for $x$ or $y$ [M1]; obtain $-2+2i$ [A1]. Total 2.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Use correct method to find either $r$ or $\theta$. If only finding $\theta$, must be looking in the correct quadrant. [M1]
Obtain $r=2\sqrt2$, or exact equivalent; follow through their $x+iy$. [A1ft]
Obtain $\theta=3\pi/4$ from exact work; follow through on $k(-1+i)$ for $k>0$ and do not ISW. [A1ft] Total 3.

parts.label: (b)
parts.answer: Greatest $\arg z=1.91$ radians; the required region is the part of the closed disc $|z-3i|\leq1$ with $\operatorname{Re}z\leq0$.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
Show a circle with centre $3i$. [B1]
Show a circle with radius 1. Follow through their centre provided it is not at the origin; for clearly unequal scales, should be an ellipse. [B1ft]
All correct with even scales and shade the correct region. [B1]
Carry out a correct method for greatest $\arg z$, e.g. $\arg z=\pi/2+\sin^{-1}(1/3)$. [M1]
Obtain 1.91. [A1] Total 5.
